# Arkheionx pre-audit readiness remediation plan

This issue was generated from an Arkheionx pre-audit readiness scan. It is not a formal audit finding. It does not confirm a vulnerability. It is a defensive remediation task for authorized repository maintainers.

- Score: `38/100`
- Score band: `Not audit-ready`
- Protocol type: `amm`
- Active readiness gaps: `13`

## Top Readiness Gaps

- [ ] `ARK-AMM-001` - AMM invariant assumptions not covered by tests (High readiness gap)
- [ ] `ARK-AMM-003` - Spot-price or reserve-price dependency without manipulation-resistance tests (High readiness gap)
- [ ] `ARK-AMM-004` - Fee-on-transfer or non-standard token assumptions not documented (Medium readiness gap)
- [ ] `ARK-AMM-005` - Slippage/min-output constraints missing or unclear (Medium readiness gap)
- [ ] `ARK-LEND-001` - Collateral/debt solvency invariant not covered by tests (Medium readiness gap)
- [ ] `ARK-LEND-002` - Liquidation boundary tests missing (Medium readiness gap)
- [ ] `ARK-LEND-005` - Reserve/cash accounting assumptions not covered (Medium readiness gap)
- [ ] `ARK-LEND-004` - Oracle-dependent borrowing/liquidation without stale-price tests (Low readiness gap)
- [ ] `ARK-ORC-001` - Oracle-dependent logic without stale-price tests (Low readiness gap)
- [ ] `ARK-ORC-002` - Oracle usage lacks visible staleness, TWAP, bounds, or sanity coverage (Low readiness gap)

## Generated Artifacts

- Markdown Report: `examples/reports/amm-lending-hybrid-fixture-pre-audit-report.md`
- Json Report: `examples/reports/amm-lending-hybrid-fixture-pre-audit-report.json`
- Sarif Report: `examples/reports/amm-lending-hybrid-fixture.sarif.json`
- Issue Plan: `examples/reports/amm-lending-hybrid-fixture-issue-plan.json`

This plan is a readiness tracker, not a formal audit report.
